item.title: Workshop Teaches Building a Competitive Intelligence AI Agent in 3 Hours
item.description:
Workshop Teaches Building a Competitive Intelligence AI Agent in 3 Hours

A new online workshop, “3 Hours to Research Intelligence: Build Your First AI Agent,” lets participants create a custom AI research agent that can save 10+ hours a week on job‑search or competitive‑analysis tasks.

🔍 Overview

  • Current research is fragmented: scattered reviews, Google searches, LinkedIn checks, and missed details.
  • The workshop promises to replace that manual workflow with an automated agent built in just 3 hours.

🛠️ What You’ll Build

  • Fork a ready‑made competitive‑intelligence agent from GitHub.
  • Wire in your own data sources – RSS feeds, open APIs, or any available feed.
  • Feed the agent a company or industry keyword.
  • Receive structured intelligence including recent news, hiring patterns, market positioning, gaps, and red‑flags.
  • Walk away with a deployed agent you can run 100 + times.

⏱️ Workshop Format

  • Duration: 3 hours, online.
  • Pre‑work (optional, 10 min): Clone the repo, set up your API key, verify it runs.
  • Live steps:
    1. Clone the GitHub repository.
    2. Add custom data sources.
    3. Test on a real company or competitor.
    4. Export a post‑work recap doc covering what you built, iteration tips, advanced techniques, and troubleshooting.
  • If you skip the pre‑work, the instructor will set everything up in the first 20 minutes.

🎯 Who It’s For

  • Job seekers who want to research a target employer before applying, interviewing, or accepting an offer.
  • Competitors analysts needing market gaps, hiring trends, and strategic moves.
  • Employees and side‑hustlers looking for a repeatable research workflow.

⚙️ Technical Requirements

  • A laptop with a web browser capable of accessing Claude.ai.
  • Basic comfort with Claude (already asking questions and iterating).
  • Access to RSS feeds or APIs you wish to incorporate.

📊 Modes of Use

Mode Purpose
Job Seeker Mode Research a company before you apply, interview, or accept an offer; understand growth, hiring, leadership, red‑flags.
Competitive Mode Understand what competitors are doing, market gaps, hiring trends, strategic moves.

💰 Pricing

  • One‑time fee of $17–27, covering all materials and the post‑work recap document.
  • Optional upsell: an Advanced Agent Techniques course (separate paid offering).

✅ Outcomes

  • Participants finish the session ready to run their own intelligence agent immediately.
  • The agent can be reused across dozens of companies or industries, delivering consistent, structured insights.

#AIagents #CompetitiveIntelligence #Productivity #CareerDevelopment

Source: 3 Hours to Research Intelligence: Build Your First AI Agent

item.title: LogicMojo AI Certification Course Rated Deep Across Full Stack for 2026 Hiring
item.description:
LogicMojo AI Certification Course Rated Deep Across Full Stack for 2026 Hiring

LogicMojo published a ranking of AI certification courses for 2026, highlighting one programme that scores Deep on every layer of its six‑layer stack.

🔍 Overview

  • Hundreds of programmes now sit between ₹0 and ₹4L+ with near‑identical landing pages, hiring logos and “industry‑recognised certificate” claims.
  • A certification is described as a receipt, not a result.
  • The ranking is disclosed as published by LogicMojo, which is ranked #1.
  • Five expert reviewers (Suvom Shaw, Rishabh Gupta, Sankalp Jain, Monesh Venkul Vommi, Mohamed Shirhaan) fact‑checked the analysis.
  • Ten courses were scored on a single question: “If I start now with a job, a laptop and 8–12 hours a week, how quickly does this make me genuinely hireable?”

⚙️ Scoring Methodology

  • Six open pillars form the scoring framework.
  • Coverage is a weighted share of the 17 Table 2 skill areas (Deep 4 · Good 3 · Moderate 2 · Basic 1).
  • Reach is an indicative brand‑recognition index (author estimate, not enrolment data).
  • Seven tables and ten reviews support the scores.
  • Every section names where other options beat the evaluated programme.

📚 Curriculum Depth

  • Foundations start from Python and data handling; maths is taught as intuition tied to model behaviour.
  • Core ML covers ensembles, metric selection, imbalanced data and error analysis.
  • Deep learning includes real training runs, not just architecture diagrams.
  • The programme is the only one rated Deep on all six layers, including the three commonly skipped layers: production RAG, fine‑tuning and agents.

🚀 Delivery & Career Support

  • Live teaching delivered in Indian time zones.
  • Every project is peer‑reviewed and portfolio‑ready.
  • Support includes mentorship, resume preparation, mock interviews, job referrals and placement assistance.
  • The author could not verify any placement rate and therefore makes no claim about it.

💰 Value & Pricing

  • Depth comparable to programmes normally priced above ₹2L+ is offered at a mid‑band price.
  • No parallel catalogue of marketing, finance or product courses competes for curriculum attention; the syllabus is kept current.

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides a faster path to a job‑ready AI profile aligned with 2026 hiring needs.
  • Helps differentiate genuine depth from superficial certificates that merely act as receipts.
  • Enables learners to assess options side‑by‑side based on live teaching, curriculum quality, practical projects and career support.

#AICertification #JobReadyAI #AIEducation

Source: Top 10 Best AI Certification Courses to Become Job Ready Faster (2026)
